name: Quixotic ExchangeV4 missing buyer authorization
summary: ExchangeV4.fillSellOrder validates only the seller signature, then pulls ERC-20 payment from the caller-supplied buyer without buyer authorization. The attacker signed sales of a fake ERC-1155 token and named allowance-holding wallets as buyers, draining OP and WETH.
notes: Direct immutable ExchangeV4 runtime contains the missing buyer authorization; ordinary registry wiring and currency approval do not introduce that defect.

Exact victim debits across 891 successful calls, including the 2.5% marketplace fee. No attacker input is subtracted from victims: payment comes directly from the named buyers. Later recovery, swaps and bridge transfers are excluded. Optimism WETH is valued at the contemporaneous Ethereum WETH quote (1:1 ETH units).
